labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a new SpeedColumn progress column, which is new behaviour.

body:
New features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there with the proposed `SpeedColumn` API.

Meanwhile, a custom unit is possible today by subclassing `ProgressColumn` in [rich/progress.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) and formatting `task.speed` yourself. `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` also shows speed when the total is unknown. Related: #3835.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
